fit_linear_references: fit linear element references from a dataset using least squares regression with configurable batch size and seed
create_element_references_from_state_dic: create LinearReferences object from a PyTorch state dict or saved .pt file
create_element_references_from_npz: create LinearReferences object from a numpy .npz file with element reference coefficients
dereference_energy: remove element references from energy values to isolate residual energy within noise bounds
test_fit_seed_reproducibility: test that fitting linear references with the same seed produces reproducible results
